sources.title: Broncos sign rookie CB Paul Manning
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Broncos insider Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos are signing rookie cornerback Paul Manning. He attended the Broncos’ rookie minicamp this past weekend on a tryout basis and must have impressed the team because they signed him to their 91-man roster today. To make room for Manning, the Broncos waived rookie cornerback […]
